subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra immersion and ops handoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra immersion and ops handoff

Hi Samir —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the candid walkthrough of NovaCorp's inference priorities and the constraints on data residency for the East Coast fleet. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the right folks in:

- Goal: 60–90 minute technical immersion with your ML infra + ops leads to validate performance targets, deployment topology, and a mutual action plan for pilot (capacity, SLOs, integrations).
- Suggested attendees (from our side): me (pre-sales/solutions), Monica (solutions engineer, infra runbook), Marissa (customer success, onboarding lead).
- From your side: ML lead, infra/ops engineer, and one product owner for acceptance criteria.

Can you confirm who will join from NovaCorp and two 90-minute windows in the next 7–10 business days that work for the broader team? If helpful, we can do 60 minutes with a focused agenda, but prefer 75–90 to allow time for a quick run and NA/EU region routing discussion.

I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and a 1-page prep checklist. If you have an existing ops runbook or compliance notes, please share ahead of the call.

Proposed agenda (draft):
1) 10m — Objectives & success criteria
2) 20m — Current infra snapshot + constraints (your team)
3) 25–35m — Redwood architecture walkthrough and perf/cost tradeoffs (batching, KV cache, quantization options)
4) 10–20m — Integration touchpoints + rollout plan (canary, fallback, metrics)
5) 10m — Open Qs & next actions (documentation, trial capacity)

If you prefer a calendar invite, say the word and we’ll propose slots. Appreciate the quick confirmation on attendees so we route the right engineers.

Thanks,

— Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: tdx-prep-checklist.md (Markdown, 4KB)

- Wed May 5, 10:00–11:30am ET (convert: 07:00–08:30 PT)

One ask — in the architecture walkthrough, can you include examples of the fallback policy you mentioned (how Redwood routes to cheaper model variants during capacity spikes)? That will be a key decision point for ops.

Best,
